label: Thai Nithet (Fak Kham) · อักษรฝักขาม
lede: Thai Nithet (Fak Kham) · อักษรฝักขาม accounts for 1 catalogued manuscript. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this script). Dated witnesses run 1827–1827 CE (1 of 1 carry a date).

findings.title: The minority hands: scripts beyond Tham Lanna
findings.gloss: Almost the whole collection is written in Tham Lanna.
